seo.description: Ride through the Andes visiting Maras, Moray, and the Salt Mines on an exciting cycling adventure from Cusco.

summary: Ride through the Andes visiting Maras, Moray, and the Salt Mines on an exciting cycling adventure from Cusco.

itinerary.title: Day 1: Bike Maras, Moray and Salineras in PRIVATE  (07hrs De Tour)
itinerary.body: According to the agreed time, our guide will take our transport to your hotel to the starting point of the bicycle trip, Chancadora, located close to the archaeological complex of Chinchero (3873m above sea level) where we will prepare all the equipment to begin our adventure on two wheels. We will visit Laguna Huaypo, passing along dirt roads until we reach Cruzpata. We’ll make a tour and take a famous Inca path to the Moray archaeological zone, where we’ll take a guided tour. We will continue descending and pass through the community of Maras. We will descend to Salineras , an important place where salt is extracted by hand. Here we will have a guided tour. At the end of this journey, we will take our transport to return to the city of Cusco.
